title: ProgramRegisters
description: Typed register vocabulary of the architect program: every id-keyed register (64), its key and its row type. The generic register-row mutations (create, delete, rename, replace) carry a RegisterRow or a RegisterKey; `x-semio-collection-catalog` is the source the Rust and TypeScript catalogs beside this file are generated from.

RegisterRow.title: RegisterRow
RegisterRow.description: One typed register row, adjacently tagged by its register key.
